heroSummary: CCS's approved 2028–29 calendar lists Wednesday, August 9, 2028, as the first student day and Thursday, May 24, 2029, as the last. Fall Break is October 9–13, Thanksgiving Break is November 22–24, Winter Break is December 25–January 8, and Spring Break is April 2–6. CCS has not yet published 2028–29 late-start or building rotation schedules.

customSections.label: CCS Approved the 2028–29 Calendar on April 29, 2026
customSections.content: The Carmel Clay school board approved the 2028–29 calendar together with 2027–28. Current in Carmel reported that CCS received responses from more than 2,500 parents and 600 staff members. More than 60% of responding families preferred a weeklong Fall Break, and ending before Memorial Day was another recurring preference.

links.label: Read the April 29 calendar approval report

customSections.label: What Changes from CCS 2027–28 to 2028–29?
customSections.content: The two calendars keep a Wednesday opening, a weeklong Fall Break, and a last student day before Memorial Day. Most major dates move earlier, while Winter Break shifts five days later.

customSections.label: Late Starts and Color-Day Calendars Come Later
customSections.content: The approved district calendar covers the major school-year dates. CCS publishes late starts, Carmel High School Blue/Gold days, and middle-school color-day rotations separately through its live school calendars. Those 2028–29 schedules have not been published yet, so this page does not carry forward dates from an earlier school year.

calendarFaqs.a: Yes. The Carmel Clay school board approved the 2028–29 calendar on April 29, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Are 2028–29 CCS late-start and Blue/Gold dates available yet?
calendarFaqs.a: Not yet. CCS has published the annual district calendar, but the 2028–29 late-start, Carmel High School Blue/Gold, and middle-school color-day schedules are not yet available on the live school calendars.

calendarFaqs.q: Are return dates after 2028–29 school breaks confirmed?
calendarFaqs.a: Not yet. The approved calendar confirms the break ranges, but CCS has not published the future staff and live school calendars needed to verify when students return after each break.

calendarFaqs.q: Where should families check for 2028–29 calendar updates?
calendarFaqs.a: Check the official CCS District Calendar page and your child's live school calendar. Those sources will list staff dates, late starts, building events, and color-day schedules as CCS publishes them.
